sections.indications_and_usage: USES: • For the temporary relief of symptoms including: • appetite support • stomach fullness • glp support • craving support • liver support • energy support • inflammation support • satiety • stomach support These statements are based upon homeopathic principles. They have not been reviewed by the Food and Drug Administration.
sections.dosage_and_administration: DIRECTIONS: 1-10 drops under the tongue, 3 times a day or as directed by a health professional. Consult a physician for use in children under 12 years of age.
sections.warnings_and_cautions: WARNINGS: If pregnant or breastfeeding, ask a health professional before use. Keep out of reach of children. In case of overdose, contact a physician or Poison Control Center right away. Tamper Evident: Sealed for your protection. Do not use if seal is broken or missing.
